mapper.select: select * from lab_rectification where id=#{rectificationId} and del_flag='0' for update
select * from lab_rectification where hazard_id=#{hazardId} and del_flag='0' order by round_no
select coalesce(max(round_no),0) from lab_rectification where hazard_id=#{hazardId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.update: update lab_rectification set reviewer_id=#{reviewerId},review_result=#{result},review_reason=#{reason},reviewed_at=#{reviewedAt},update_time=#{reviewedAt},version=version+1 where id=#{rectificationId} and reviewer_id is null and version=#{expectedVersion} and del_flag='0'
